description: This file defines the GeoPlacesClient class, a specialized client for interacting with the Amazon Location Service Places V2 API. It includes method annotations for various operations such as autocomplete, geocode, getPlace, reverseGeocode, searchNearby, searchText, and suggest, along with their async variants.

classes.name: GeoPlacesClient
classes.description: A client class for Amazon Location Service Places V2, extending the AWS SDK's AwsClient.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Performs an autocomplete query to find place suggestions based on input.

methods.name: geocode
methods.description: Performs geocoding to convert addresses or place names into geographic coordinates.

methods.name: getPlace
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific place.

methods.name: reverseGeocode
methods.description: Converts geographic coordinates into a human-readable address.

methods.name: searchNearby
methods.description: Searches for places nearby a specific location.

methods.name: searchText
methods.description: Searches for places matching a text query.

methods.name: suggest
methods.description: Provides place suggestions based on partial input.
